name: Taskbar Accent Color Controller
description: Shows your accent color on Start and the taskbar, and optionally sets a custom accent.
author: AETHER

compatibility.notes: Windows only shows the accent on the taskbar while the system (Windows) mode is dark.

settings.label: Show accent on Start and taskbar
Show accent on title bars and window borders

documentation.whatItChanges: HKCU\...\Themes\Personalize\ColorPrevalence, HKCU\Software\Microsoft\Windows\DWM (ColorPrevalence, AccentColor, ColorizationColor) and HKCU\...\Explorer\Accent (AccentColorMenu, StartColorMenu, AccentPalette).
documentation.uninstall: All values are restored from the snapshot taken when the mod was enabled.
